purpose: Class-level engineering/performance overlay for IJN CA/CL where detailed individual audits are absent. Values are coarse sensitivities, not universal combat multipliers.
global_nonstacking_rules: Do not stack class engineering percentages with global TECH-GUNFIRE-SURFACE or torpedo reliability/accuracy modifiers as if independent hit-rate bonuses.
Class overlay primarily changes realized speed/reliability/fuel/repairability/DC/I-O and bad-tail probability, not armor thickness, shell energy, or nominal weapon count.
Individual refit date, individual radar fit, damage/repair state, ammunition state, crew state and theater availability override class profile.
Radar prewire/power/plotting integration is not radar detection-range or SG-equivalence.
Historical post-divergence conversions/refits are causal gates, not automatic calendar events.

branch_delta.speed: do not increase headline rating; healthy practical sustained performance centered about historical 33 kt, with ~0.1–0.3 kt-equivalent retention benefit
branch_delta.dc_io: moderate improvement in drainage/fire-main/electrical isolation and calibration; no armor multiplier
